​

"We have a special team," Dončić wrote. "We know what you expect, and we are going to do everything in our power to deliver it.

"From the moment I arrived in LA, you welcomed me with open arms. That is something I will never forget.

"So here is my promise to you: we are going to give you everything we have, every single night. No excuses. No nights off."

The Lakers open the regular season Wednesday night against the Golden State Warriors (10 p.m. ET, ESPN).

Source: https://www.espn.com/nba/story/\_/id/50238836/luka-don%C4%8Di%C4%87-asks-lakers-fans-support-special-team
